Oaminal |blank1_name = Political party |blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|Lakas-CMD}}|border=darkgray}} [[Lakas-CMD]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Misamis Occidental's 2nd congressional district''' is one of the two [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Misamis Occidental]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 21, 2021}} The district encompasses the southern half of the province consisting of its largest city, [[Ozamiz]], the adjacent city of [[Tangub]], and the municipalities of [[Bonifacio, Misamis Occidental|Bonifacio]], [[Clarin, Misamis Occidental|Clarin]], [[Don Victoriano]], [[Sinacaban]] and [[Tudela, Misamis Occidental|Tudela]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 21, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by Sancho Fernando Oaminal of the [[Lakas-CMD]]{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=November 18, 2022}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
